_about: Hand-written adjustments applied by kb:build on top of the model-generated records. These are editorial judgements, not measured data.
_symptom_entry_min_df: A catalogue entry whose name is itself a symptom used by at least this many conditions (Fever, Chest pain, Dizziness...) is dropped: answering 'fever' with 'Fever' tells the user nothing.
_force_rare_name_pattern: Staged or recurrent forms of a cancer duplicate the parent entry; they are kept but ranked as rare.

regional_prevalence._about: Prevalence labels in the source reflect a US reference. These conditions are endemic in India and are ranked as common. Curated list, not derived from surveillance data.

_extra_conditions: Conditions relevant in India that the source catalogue does not list. Written from model knowledge (basis = model).
_body_model_aliases: Symptom ids used by the 3D body picker that do not match a vocabulary term on their own, mapped by hand.
